remarks: Welcome to 88 York Street! This wonderful west side home offers classic Buffalo curb appeal with a beautifully updated, modern interior. From the wraparound covered front porch to the manicured landscaping, this home makes a great first impression. Extensively renovated less than 15 years ago, the interior has the feel of something much newer. Filled with natural light, the first floor offers a comfortable living room and a very large formal dining room with plenty of space for gatherings large and small. The bright, updated kitchen features cream cabinetry, granite counters, stainless steel appliances, built-in microwave, electric cooktop, tile backsplash and a peninsula with seating for two. Additional main level highlights include a bedroom that also works well as a home office or flex space, a half bath and convenient first-floor laundry. Upstairs you’ll find two very spacious bedrooms with interesting architectural ceiling lines, generous closet space and direct access from both bedrooms to the updated full bath with dual vanity, ceramic tile, tiled tub/shower and a large storage closet. Outdoor living is easy with a Trex deck directly off the kitchen leading to a large stamped concrete patio and fully fenced yard with a large storage shed. Additional features include hardwood floors throughout, zoned electric heat, on-demand hot water and a clean partial basement with Bilco door access. The location is hard to beat, just minutes from Kleinhans Music Hall and Symphony Circle and close to the shops and restaurants along Connecticut Street and Elmwood Avenue. D’Youville University, BreadHive, BFLO Pizza Bistro, Augie’s and Southern Junction are all just a short walk away. Showings will begin immediately.
